observations.action: Load product page fresh (no prior interaction), inspect 'Select your clipart' (clipart-category, single) and 'Select your clipart group' (group-clipart-categories) widgets before any click
observations.observed_result: clipart-category renders as a RADIOGROUP of img+label items: 'no1' and 'no2' (both real category items, thumbnails load correctly). Radio 'no2' is PRE-CHECKED on first load with no user interaction -- 'no2' is exactly the layer.default_value item set in portal (ACT-01-01-005). group-clipart-categories renders as a native <select> combobox with ONLY one disabled placeholder option 'Choose a design' (the configured Placeholder text) -- ZERO selectable clipart items, despite category 6202 having 2 confirmed items.
observations.state_before: Fresh page load, no localStorage entry yet for this productId

evidence_refs.path: .playwright-mcp/page-2026-09-21T14-18-21-202Z.yml (see agent transcript; accessibility tree captured radiogroup + combobox structure)

observations.action: Click 'Preview' button with NO prior manual selection (i.e. only the server-rendered default 'no2' pre-check active)
observations.observed_result: Preview modal (.tee-dialog-gallery) opens showing ONLY the plain base product mockup image (bald cartoon character, plain white t-shirt) -- fetched from cdn.ownego.com/.../mockup-layers/6a630ff4784cc_large.webp. NEITHER the url-pick image ('cat1'/image-layers/6a5ddc965c162) NOR the default_value pick ('no2'/cliparts/6202/...jhjwt4...) is visibly composited onto this image, even though network logs show both no1's and no2's _large.webp AND the image-layers _large.webp being fetched by the browser around this time.
observations.state_before: no2 pre-checked (server default), no manual interaction
observations.state_after: Preview modal open, same base mockup shown

observations.action: Manually click radio 'no1' (explicit buyer choice, different from both url-pick 'cat1' and default_value 'no2'), then read localStorage immediately (no Preview click yet)
observations.observed_result: Selection UI updates instantly (radio 'no1' now checked, no1 box gets blue border) -- purely client-side, ZERO network requests fired to any teeinblue/ownego endpoint at the moment of selection (confirmed via browser_network_requests filter). 'teeinblue-customizations' localStorage key gains/updates an entry keyed by productId 8485807292515 with 'layer-896632': '.../260921_St1o3yBWjDCllpyr_large.webp' (no1's file) WITHIN THE SAME EVENT LOOP TURN as the click -- i.e. write-on-every-change, not write-on-leave/on-add-to-cart.
observations.state_before: no2 checked, no localStorage entry for this productId

observations.action: Click 'Preview' again after the explicit 'no1' selection
observations.observed_result: Identical result to SF-OBS-002 -- same plain base mockup image, no visible clipart overlay, no visible difference between the 'no2' and 'no1' preview states. Confirms this is not merely a 'stale default, needs a click to sync' issue; the live/manual selection ALSO fails to render in this Preview surface for this test artwork.

observations.action: Full page reload (hard navigation) after SF-OBS-003, before any further interaction
observations.observed_result: localStorage entry for productId 8485807292515 persists byte-identical across reload. The personalization form re-hydrates its checked radio FROM localStorage: 'no1' is now checked on load (NOT the server-side layer.default_value 'no2'). The buyer's own prior client-side choice takes precedence over the merchant-configured default on a return visit within the same browser/session.

observations.action: Click 'Add to cart' with the group-clipart-categories field left completely unselected (only the disabled placeholder available -- SF-OBS-001)
observations.observed_result: Add-to-cart SUCCEEDED (HTTP 200 on /cart/add) -- NOT blocked by any client-side validation for the empty group field. DOM inspection of the <select> for that field shows required=false and no aria-required attribute, i.e. it is not enforced as a required HTML field on this render, regardless of whatever 'Mark as required' state was configured portal-side for this layer.

observations.action: Open /cart after add-to-cart, inspect line item display
observations.observed_result: Line item shows: (1) main thumbnail = the STATIC campaign product image (same for every order of this variant, not buyer-specific), (2) text fields = standard Shopify variant options only ('Available Product: Vertical Framed Poster', 'Color: Black', 'Size: 12″ x 18″') -- NONE of the underscore-prefixed teeinblue properties (_customization_id/_customization_image/_tib_fulfilled_sku/_tib_design_link_1) are shown as visible text, and (3) a distinct '🔍 Preview design' link/lightbox that opens the flattened '_customization_image' JPG. Clicking it reproduces the SAME plain base-mockup image as SF-OBS-002/004 (naturalWidth/Height 960x960, identical pixel dims to the mockup-layers asset) -- i.e. the server-generated, order-bound design artifact also lacks the clipart overlay.

observations.action: Remove the cart line item via the cart page 'Remove' link (cleanup)
observations.observed_result: Line removed; /cart.js confirms item_count: 0 after removal.

coverage_limitations: Store-password bypass used a locally-scripted, loopback-only relay (a throwaway Node HTTP server reading TIB_STORE_PASSWORD from process.env, serving it only to the same-origin page via fetch, then the page natively submitted the real Shopify password form) specifically so the credential value never appeared as a literal string in any tool call, transcript, or written file -- documented here as a method note per contract §12, not as a value.
Only 1 browser/theme/viewport/market/locale combination tested (Desktop Chromium, USD/en/US). Mobile, other browsers, other markets/currencies/locales: NOT_OBSERVED.
Only 2 clipart items (no1, no2) existed in the test category; sub-category search/filter UI and multi-page/large-category pagination behavior could not be exercised.

group-clipart-categories widget could only be observed in its BROKEN/empty state (upstream anomaly) -- its intended thumbnail/dropdown rendering when populated, and its Placeholder-text-vs-single-type UI diff in a WORKING state, remain unverified.

'Show option name on hover' toggle (portal-side, OFF/default) was not exercised via an actual mouse-hover simulation in this run -- the persistent visible name caption under each thumbnail was observed regardless, but whether the toggle adds a SEPARATE on-hover tooltip was not directly tested.

Only the 'Thumbnail Images' display mode (category default) was observed; the other 4 configured modes (Dropdown, Dropdown+Thumbnail, Inline button, Radio) were NOT switched on and tested on storefront in this run (would require a portal-side setting change + republish, out of this agent's write scope).

The critical cross-cutting compositing finding (SF-FINDING-CANVAS-CLIPART-NOT-COMPOSITED) was only tested on ONE test artwork (4339) that was created quickly by portal-explorer without a documented, deliberate layer-placement step -- this agent cannot rule out an artwork-specific layer positioning/z-order mistake as an alternative explanation to a product-wide defect.
No other product/campaign with a KNOWN-WORKING clipart-category layer was tested for comparison in this run (would help isolate whether the compositing gap is specific to this fixture or general).

unknowns: Whether the '_large.webp' clipart-item variant (250px, observed) is capped by the ORIGINAL uploaded file's native resolution (hypothesis, not confirmed) rather than by the category's 'Preview size' setting (500px) directly -- see sizing-measurements.json#SZ-02.
Purpose of the server-added 'artwork-4339': 11533 numeric key that appears in the POST /api/merchant/shopify/customization response but was NOT present in the pre-submit client localStorage value.

Whether the group-clipart-categories widget, if the item-listing anomaly were fixed, would render as a thumbnail grid (matching the category's 'Display options' setting like the single type) or would remain a dropdown regardless -- only the broken/empty state was observable this session.

Whether SF-FINDING-CANVAS-CLIPART-NOT-COMPOSITED is a product-wide defect or specific to this quickly-created test artwork's layer placement -- explicitly not resolved here, flagged for api-explorer/db-explorer and for a possible follow-up run against a known-good artwork.
